title: Animal Crossing
shortDescription: A human moves into a rural village populated by anthropomorphic animals operating on the console's internal real-time clock.
historicalSignificance: Founded Nintendo's gentle social simulation titan, pioneering calendar holiday events and furniture collecting.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
